title: Blues and gospel notebook; the church
summary: She shows her blues and gospel notebook and says the only difference between them is the words.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Maybe after you had all your power cut off and the heat cut off, maybe you'll write some new blues about that.

Good.
I don't never stop writing blues. I

always keep some on ice, waiting.

I keeps it -- there it is, right there. Blues black book, blues. Gospel on one side, blues on the other.
Oh, you write gospel, too? You still write gospel?

Yeah, yeah, I write gospel too, because they want to hear gospel and I'll make them something for the gospel, too, because that's all ______. If you can sing gospel, you can sing blues.
